newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco sees flat to lower first half net.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco sees flat to lower first half net.

text.p: Sonoco Products Co sees flat to slightly lower earnings in the first half of 1997, with results for the full year in line with its 10 to 15 percent historical growth rates, the company said Friday.
In a statement reporting a presentation to securithy analysts, Sonoco said 1996 will be another record year following 1995's 28 percent earnings increase.
Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate and reporters were not invited to the meeting.
The First Call consensus shows the company earning $1.73 per share this year, up from $1.64 last year.
The First Call consensus for the fourth quarter is $0.43 per share compared with $0.42 in last year's final three months.
"We are optimistic that 1997 is going to be a good year, with earnings flat or down slightly in the first half and gaining momentum thereafter," Sonoco's statement said.

"Obviously in 1996, we are comparing to very strong gains in the same quarters of 1995. The price decreases we led and the subsequent stabilizing of selling prices will make quarter to quarter comparisons through the third quarter of 1997 very difficult," the company continued.
It said 1996 capital spending was a record $250 million.
